feedback: The confession follows the evidence already available: Chip retracts the material denial, connects his closure work to opening the bottle, and confirms poisoning the glass he admitted handling. The precise timing of opening during the preview is newly stated, but not a new decisive clue required to choose him. His discussion of the nonunique scrap fairly respects the report’s limitation. The closing line about trusted hands gives his professional role emotional force without changing the solution. Barb’s promise to surrender her badge and protect service staff also feels earned. Hugh’s concession fits his defensive earlier voice. The ending is satisfying, although Chip explains the evidentiary sequence with somewhat unusually tidy self-analysis.
